answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a critical mesa for validating identity by tethering network influence to collateralized capital rather than compute. A time-locked beacon broadcasts serialized checkpoints, ensuring that agents cannot spoof identities without owning substantial stake. This forces a high capital cost upon attackers, as acquiring enough influence to manipulate the willow of consensus requires massive, verifiable investment that makes large-scale Sybil attacks economically irrational.
